purpose: Compaction takeover as a client-side harness event: a valid sole compact_context ends the request with the authentic tool_call only; the client forks, appends one compaction meta step to the original, selects the fork and sends nothing for it; placeStepsForModel keeps the call and the harness step off every wire request.

public_api.name: buildCompactionHarnessStep
public_api.description: The meta/compaction step appended to the original; data.forkConversationId = fork.id.

public_api.name: placeStepsForModel
public_api.signature: <T extends PlacementStep>(steps: ReadonlyArray<T>, input: PlaceStepsInput) => T[]
public_api.description: Now also omits unanswered compact_context tool_calls and the compaction harness step.

owned_data: compaction harness step on the original conversation
